declarations.name: groupCardNumber
declarations.description: Groups a card number the way it is embossed: 4-6-5 for a 15-digit number (American Express), fours otherwise.

A company card the way Brex, Mercury and Ramp show one: the card face, masked until the reader asks to see it, then
the number, expiry and security code, each with a copy button.

The full number never sits in an attribute. The masked face is described by `label`, `holder` and `last4`; "Show
details" fires `reveal-request`, and the app fetches the details (behind a re-authentication, usually) and sets
the `details` property to `{ number, expiry, cvc }`. Until then the button runs and the number line is a skeleton;
`revealFailed()` returns to the masked face. The card masks itself again after `hide-after` seconds, when the page
is hidden, and through `hide()`, each time dropping `details` from memory.

`frozen` greys the face, adds a "Frozen" badge and turns reveal off. The face is designed dark, so its colours stay
in both themes; restyle it through its variables (`--c2-payment-card__face--background` takes any gradient), and
hide the chip, the expiry row or the button row through their display variables for a compact card in a list.

members.name: label
members.description: What the card is for ("Marketing team · Virtual"), top left; also its accessible name.

members.name: last4
members.description: The last four digits, shown on the masked face.

members.name: details
members.description: The details to show. Set it, as a property only, after `reveal-request`; `hide()` clears it.

members.name: hideAfter
members.description: Seconds the details stay shown before the card masks itself again. 0 keeps them until `hide()`.

members.name: frozen
members.description: A frozen card: greyed, badged, and its details cannot be shown.

members.name: reveal
members.description: Asks for the details, as the button does: fires `reveal-request` and shows the loading state.

members.name: hide
members.description: Masks the card again and drops the details from memory.

members.name: revealFailed
members.description: Ends a reveal that could not complete (the app could not fetch the details): back to the masked face.

members.name: handleVisibility
members.description: A hidden tab is a card nobody watches: mask it.

events.name: reveal-request
events.description: Fired when the reader asks to see the details: fetch them and set `details`, or call `revealFailed()`. Does not bubble.

events.name: copy
events.description: Fired after a field was copied. Does not bubble.
